Strategy: Spread-gated switch: when the feasible residuals span more than one item size, use worst fit to preserve tight bins, otherwise use tightest fit; the wide-pool mode spreads items while the narrow-pool mode consolidates. It can fail when a wide pool is caused by one outlier bin and worst fit keeps feeding that outlier.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [(r if max(bins) - min(bins) > item else -(r - item)) for r in bins]
```
